description: Damping rate of |y·chi| across H_6 partitions. Top partition (5,1) carries 44%. Top 4 (all 2-row) carry 95%. Sharp 4× dropoff at the 2-row→3-row boundary (rank 4→5: ×0.24). 2-row partitions dominate because the Borromean braid has 3 strands per nucleon — interface connects row 1 to row 2, ≥3 rows are inert. Consistent with paper O1 (trace-dominance of long-string partitions).
